approach: Static recompilation of the PPU and SPU code to x86-64 with a native Vulkan runtime, FSR 3.1.5 upscaling, FSR 3.1.6 frame generation, and SDL3 input and haptics
notes: Native Steam Deck and Linux (Vulkan) port built from the player's own European BCES00220 disc dump. No game code, firmware, or assets are distributed.
